# AUDIO PROFILE
Derek, a working-class man from Liverpool in his fifties, Sandra's husband.

## THE SCENE
Inside the machine's building: a vast, silent, spotless clean room, white and futuristic, a hundred people in white suits settling into chairs they know they will not get up from. A soft, dead, hushed acoustic, no echo; voices close and quiet.

### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Emotion for this line: whispered, tender and close, almost no voice at all; holding her hand; a man saying goodbye without saying it.
Style: indignant and exasperated in the row, arms-in-the-air disbelief; in the circle, angry and frightened, the first one to say no.
Pace: bursts, getting louder.
Accent: Scouse, as heard in Liverpool. Never American, never Received Pronunciation.

### SAMPLE CONTEXT
The voice you'd cast as the bloke in a British sitcom who is losing an argument and knows it.
